note: BCEL (Banque pour le Commerce Extérieur Lao): its card service fees (the schedule made 26 June 2026) charge a Visa Classic credit card's primary card $30 a year and 16% a year on a balance carried; the $20 registration fee isn't written, nor the approval fee of 0.5% of the approved limit on an unsecured card, which depends on a limit the game's cards don't keep.
